ratios.quote: At March 31, 2026, Caterpillar’s consolidated net worth was $18.730 billion, which was above the $9.000 billion required under the Credit Facility.

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial covenant interest coverage ratio
ratios.quote: At March 31, 2026, Cat Financial’s covenant interest coverage ratio was 1.53 to 1.

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial six-month covenant leverage ratio
ratios.quote: In addition, at March 31, 2026, Cat Financial’s six-month covenant leverage ratio was 8.03 to 1. This was below the maximum ratio of debt to net worth of 10 to 1

parsed.notes: Consolidated net worth is a dollar test, shown in billions of USD; it is defined as shareholders' equity including preferred stock, excluding the pension/OPEB balance in AOCI. The Cat Financial ratios apply to Caterpillar's wholly owned, consolidated finance subsidiary, which is a party to the same Credit Facility. Its leverage ratio is debt to net worth, not debt to EBITDA, so it is classed as 'other'. That ratio is a six-month average of month-end ratios. The interest coverage ratio uses the trailing four quarters and excludes net gain or loss from interest rate derivatives. There were no borrowings under the Credit Facility at March 31, 2026.
